name: Frontend Slides
description: Generates a polished single-file HTML slide deck (inline CSS/JS, keyboard navigation, 16:9, print-friendly) from a title and slide outline in one of 6 curated visual styles. Use when the user asks for a pitch deck, presentation, or slideshow. Save the returned HTML with the save-files skill.
author: BMI AI Assistant

examples.prompt: Make a pitch deck for my AI startup
examples.call: {"title": "Acme AI — Seed Pitch", "theme": "bold-signal", "slides": "[{\"heading\": \"The problem\", \"bullets\": [\"Teams drown in docs\", \"Search misses context\"]}]"}

examples.prompt: Create a team update presentation in a light editorial style

title.description: Deck title shown on the cover slide. Required.

slides.description: JSON array of slide objects: [{"heading": "...", "bullets": ["...", "..."], "kicker": "optional eyebrow"}]. 1-30 slides. Required.

theme.description: Visual style: bold-signal (dark, high-impact), electric-studio (clean split), notebook-tabs (editorial paper), split-pastel (playful), terminal-green (developer), swiss-modern (minimal). Default bold-signal.

author.description: Presenter or company name shown on the cover. Optional.
